description: A skipped lesson that names its gate item by `item` is checked against that item only (sweep-decide-apply.md, Skip records): the 2026-10-22 G4 shape (a whole-file target whose file also holds an Applied item, g1) is accepted when it names the plain Skip g2, and the stored record drops `item`. A lesson naming an Applied item, an item decisions.json does not hold, a for_conflict Skip, or an item of another file is exit 3, nothing written. A Skip of another item never backs it: g3 (plain Skip, shared/AGENTS.md) does not back a lesson naming g1.
